background.value: white, uniform, smooth (uniforme blanco y liso)

expression_restriction.value: neutral expression, no smiles or gestures

glasses_policy.value: transparent lenses only; dark-tinted glasses (gafas de cristales oscuros) not permitted; no reflections allowed

headwear_policy.value: not permitted except for religious reasons with justification; oval of face must remain completely visible from hairline to chin

face_visibility.value: full face oval visible including eyebrows, eyes, nose, mouth and chin (el ovalo de la cara, que incluye cejas, ojos, nariz, boca y menton); taken from front

file_spec.value: high resolution on quality photographic paper (alta resolucion en papel fotografico de buena calidad)

size.evidence: The cited official source (dnielectronico.es, the official DNI portal) confirms the photo size as '32 x 26 milimetros'. This was directly fetched and verified. The notation '32 x 26mm' follows Spanish official convention of height x width (the photo is 26mm wide and 32mm tall in portrait orientation). Multiple independent sources confirm this unique Spanish format: photogov.net lists 'es-passport-32x26mm', visafoto.com confirms 26x32mm (width x height notation), mybiometricphotos.com confirms the same. Spain notably uses a smaller format than the standard European 35x45mm. Both passport and DNI use this same 32x26mm (or equivalently 26x32mm in WxH) specification.
